entities.name: UEAssistanceInformation message
entities.description: RRC message used by UE to provide various assistance information to the network including delay budget reports, overheating assistance, IDC assistance, power saving preferences, and other UE capabilities.

entities.name: Timer T345
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of overheating assistance information, set to overheatingIndicationProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346a
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of DRX preference information for a cell group, set to drx-PreferenceProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346b
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of maximum bandwidth preference information for a cell group, set to maxBW-PreferenceProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346c
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of maximum component carrier preference information for a cell group, set to maxCC-PreferenceProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346d
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of maximum MIMO layer preference information for a cell group, set to maxMIMO-LayerPreferenceProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346e
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of minimum scheduling offset preference information for a cell group, set to minSchedulingOffsetPreferenceProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346f
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of release preference information, set to releasePreferenceProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346g
entities.description: Timer used for MUSIM assistance when leaving RRC_CONNECTED state, set to musim-LeaveWithoutResponseTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346h
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of MUSIM gap preference information, set to musim-GapProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346i
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of SCG deactivation preference, set to scg-DeactivationPreferenceProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346j
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of RLM measurement relaxation state, set to rlm-RelaxtionReportingProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Timer T346k
entities.description: Timer used to prohibit frequent transmission of BFD measurement relaxation state, set to bfd-RelaxtionReportingProhibitTimer value.

entities.name: Overheating condition detected
entities.description: Condition where UE detects overheating and needs to provide assistance information to the network.

entities.name: IDC problems detected
entities.description: Condition where UE experiences In-Device Coexistence interference problems that it cannot solve by itself on certain frequencies or UL CA combinations.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection with the network.

relations.description: Detection of overheating condition starts timer T345 to prevent frequent assistance information transmission.
Overheating condition triggers transmission of UEAssistanceInformation message with overheating assistance.
IDC problems trigger transmission of UEAssistanceInformation message with IDC assistance information.
Release preference transmission requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state and starts timer T346f.
MUSIM assistance for leaving RRC_CONNECTED requires the UE to be in connected state and starts timer T346g.
